answer: Reputation-weighted task ladder. Each agent must climb sequential work tiers; payouts scale with tier, but each tier requires a fresh escrowed deposit proportional to squared tier index. Attacker cost grows superlinearly per fake identity, while honest agents recoup deposits through completed work. A partial completion record becomes a mesa no fresh identity can inherit, and any tier-jump attempt leaves a ledge of unpaid exposure.
